title: Constructor overloading
answer: Yes. Constructors can be overloaded by declaring multiple constructors with different parameter lists. Overloading lets callers create the same class with different valid input sets while each constructor ultimately establishes a valid object. AeroTopo's abstract `Product` has both an id-only constructor and an id-plus-tiles constructor; the shorter constructor delegates to the fuller one with `this(id, List.of())`.
